verdicts.reason: v2.01.00 falls in advisory range (<=2.02.0); generate_pass_from_mac@libnvram.so.1.0:0x59c34 derives the UID-0 account password exclusively from the public device MAC through a fixed-salt DES chain crypt(mac8,'AM')->crypt(.,'ab') with zero entropy source, and additionally writes a build-time constant root hash 'abATsxpNxEp4Y' into /etc/passwd; invoked at every boot from bin/httpd (main->0xa71c->0xa770) and on MAC change via libcgi handle_mac_restart (0x257c8).
